addition.item: Added accept all, reject all and category preference controls.
Added consent withdrawal, script activation hooks and cookie cleanup patterns.
Added a public JavaScript API, lifecycle events, German and French translations.

change.item: Moved frontend markup into a Joomla layout.
Made consent state handling cache and CDN safe.
Updated the extension namespace and Web Asset Manager metadata.

security.item: Non-essential consent categories now default to denied.
Validated cookie names, consent revisions and privacy-policy URL schemes.
Adjusted control-character URL validation to avoid a JAMSS hexadecimal-notation false positive.

change.item: Cleaned up the Support and Contact backend note.

addition.item: Added JavaScript-side cookie detection and visible keyboard focus styles.
